Bash(node -e "const fs = require\('fs'\); const files = ['fellows.json', 'faculty.json', 'schedule.json', 'logistics.json', 'resources.json']; files.forEach\(f => { try { JSON.parse\(fs.readFileSync\(\\`data/\\${f}\\`\)\); console.log\(\\`✓ \\${f} is valid\\`\); } catch\(e\) { console.log\(\\`✗ \\${f} error: \\${e.message}\\`\); } }\);")
Bash(node -e "const data = require\('./data/fellows.json'\); console.log\('Total fellows:', data.fellows.length\); console.log\('Fellow names:', data.fellows.map\(f => f.name\).join\(', '\)\);")

Bash(node -e "const faculty = require\('./data/faculty.json'\); const schedule = require\('./data/schedule.json'\); const resources = require\('./data/resources.json'\); console.log\('Faculty members:', faculty.faculty.length\); console.log\('Organizing team members:', faculty.organizingTeam.length\); console.log\('Schedule days:', schedule.days.length\); console.log\('Resources:', resources.resources.length\);")
